Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Senior Software Engineer role at Kestrel Mobility. With 6 years as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, I led the order-routing service built in TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL, handling ~2M events daily—directly aligning with your event-driven routing needs. I successfully migrated a monolith to event-driven architecture with zero customer downtime using a Strangler Fig pattern, reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9s to 340ms. My experience includes PostgreSQL schema design, query tuning, and logical replication, along with Kubernetes and Terraform for deployment. I also served as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, managing a team of five across dispatch and billing systems.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
